title: Automated Safety Benchmarking: A Multi-agent Pipeline for LVLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) using a synthesized benchmark of adversarial image-question pairs. The multi-agent system generates cross-modal queries (utilizing modality dependence, complementarity, and conflict) designed to elicit discriminatory, identity-related, or stereotypical responses (e.g., gender and occupational stereotypes).
